description: This file defines the 'Container' interface for the OFBiz framework, outlining lifecycle methods (init, start, stop) for container processes and their management.

classes.name: Container
classes.description: An interface representing a container process in OFBiz, with methods for initialization, starting, stopping, and retrieving the container's name.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the container with command-line arguments, a unique name, and a configuration file (always null).

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the container process, returning true if successful.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the container instance.
